why: RJ-X70, pending AR-10 (suiteui/area-selection): Photo's catalog has no select.ellipse, select.lasso, select.invert or select.feather until AR-10, so platforms is [] and the harness skips the job on both. On a 96 x 96 portrait (a skin-toned face on grey), selects the ellipse around the face, subtracts a lasso triangle over the chin, inverts, feathers 8 px, fills the selection with the brush colour (black: no command sets it yet) and exports the PNG. The trap: Option adds instead of subtracting, the feather is ignored, or Invert selects the whole canvas. The assertion: the face centre is unchanged, the chin notch and the surround are filled, and the edge ramp from 10% to 90% filled is at least 6 px wide (PhotoAreaSelectionTests.selectShapesJobPasses). The turn-on sets platforms to linux and macos.
